identifier.description: A document's identifier, such as service or team-directory: a lowercase letter, then lowercase letters, digits, - and _ (up to 63).

name.description: A letter, then letters, digits, - and _ (up to 63).

icon.description: A Lucide icon name in kebab case, such as server, users or circle-check.

jq.description: A jq expression. Quote it, or use a |- block scalar, when YAML would read it as a list or mapping, such as [.a]. Entities are flat: properties sit beside identifier and title, so write .owner, not .properties.owner.

path.description: A field's path: a property or built-in field (identifier, title, blueprint, integration, createdAt, updatedAt), followed through relations and scorecard properties with dots, such as owner.title or readiness.tier. No $.

metadata.description: What identifies the document and how it's shown in lists.

name.description: The document's identifier. It can't change once published, since other documents and data refer to it.

title.description: The human-readable name shown in the portal.

description.description: One or two sentences saying what this is for.

color.description: Tints the icon's tile, so it needs an icon.

filter.description: A condition on entities: a comparison {property, op, value or values}, or and, or and not combining conditions. A value starting with $ is a variable: $entity is the entity whose page it is (entity pages only); $me is the viewer's email and $me.email, $me.name, $me.role and $me.groups their attributes; $input.<id> is a dashboard input (Home only); $today is the date.

property.description: The path of the field to compare, such as tier, owner.title or createdAt.

op.description: How to compare. in takes values; exists takes nothing; contains matches a list item, a related entity or text within a string; within matches dates in the last duration given as value, such as 30m, 12h, 7d or 2w; the rest take value.

value.description: What to compare with, or a variable such as $entity, $me or $input.team.

values.description: What in compares with: a list, or a variable holding several, such as $input.team.

query.description: Picks entities: those of a blueprint that match a filter.

blueprint.description: The blueprint whose entities it picks. On a blueprint's pages it defaults to that blueprint; on Home it's required.

filter.description: Keeps the entities that match. Left out, every entity of the blueprint.

queries.description: Named queries the page's widgets share, keyed by name, which widgets write in place of a query.

queryRef.description: The entities it shows: the name of one of the page's queries, or a query written in place. On a blueprint's pages, left out it's every entity of the blueprint; on Home it's required.

template.description: A template whose {{ }} hold jq, run on the widget's or row's entity, with $me, $input.<id>, $today and on entity pages $entity. What each gives is URL-escaped.

link.description: What clicking the widget opens: the catalog showing a query's entities, a URL, or a page in the portal. Exactly one of query, url and path.

query.description: Opens the catalog showing this query's entities.

filter.description: Narrows the query's entities for the link only.

group.description: Bars and donuts only: each group opens its own entities.

url.description: An http or https URL template, such as https://grafana.example.com/d/{{ .identifier }}.

path.description: A path in the portal template, starting with one /, such as /scorecards/service-readiness.

rowLink.description: What each table row opens instead of its entity's page: one of url and path, templated on the row's entity.

value.description: The number a stat shows, worked out from a query's entities: how many there are, unless it has one of sum, avg, min, max, share or jq.

unit.description: Follows the number, such as ms. sum, avg, min and max take their field's unit unless this says otherwise; share is always %, so takes none.

sum.description: The path of a number field to total.

avg.description: The path of a number field to average.

min.description: The path of a number field to take the lowest of.

max.description: The path of a number field to take the highest of.

share.description: Shows the percent of the query's entities matching this condition.

jq.description: jq over the query's entities, as a list, that gives a number. Slower than the others, so prefer them.

column.description: A table column: a field's path, or a titled column with a path or jq over the row's entity.

title.description: The column's heading. A path column defaults to its field's title.

jq.description: jq over the row's entity, giving the cell's value.

unit.description: Follows numbers in the column, such as ms.

widgetTitle.description: Shown on the widget. On Home it can hold {{ }} jq, such as {{ $me.name }}; a blueprint's pages can't.

widgetDescription.description: A line under the title saying what the widget shows.

width.description: How many of the page's 12 grid columns the widget spans.

statWidget.description: A single number, such as how many services are critical. Default width 3.

color.description: Tints the icon, so it needs an icon.

groupBy.description: The path of the field to count entities by, such as tier or owner.

barWidget.description: Bars counting a query's entities by a field. Default width 6.

limit.description: How many groups to show, largest first. Default 8.

donutWidget.description: A donut counting a query's entities by a field. Default width 4.

limit.description: How many groups to show, largest first. Default 8.

tableWidget.description: A table of a query's entities, each row opening its entity. Default width 12.

columns.description: The columns after the title column, which always comes first.

sort.description: The path of the field to sort by, with a leading - for descending, such as -updatedAt.

limit.description: How many rows to show. Default 10.

scorecardWidget.description: How a scorecard's entities spread across its tiers. Default width 6.

query.description: Narrows the scorecard's entities. The scorecard decides the blueprint, so this can leave it out.

markdownWidget.description: Text in Markdown, such as notes or links. Its {{ }} hold jq with $me, and on entity pages $entity. Default width 6.

propertiesWidget.description: Entity pages only: some of the entity's properties, in order. Default width 6.

properties.description: The properties to show, by name.

widget.description: A tile on a page. type decides which other fields it takes.

widgets.description: The widgets, keyed by identifier, laid out in the order written, left to right on a 12-column grid.

title.description: The tab's label. Defaults to its identifier.

tabs.description: Tabs of widgets, keyed by identifier, shown after the tabs every page has, in the order written.
